svg.title: Finding 1: Reliable verification does not need a large judge
svg.desc: Phi-4 (14B) reaches 90.16% and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 90.30%, equivalent within ±0.5 points. Along the Qwen3 ladder accuracy rises 9.77 points from 0.6B to 1.7B, then flattens: 0.54 from 8B to 14B and 0.23 from 14B to 32B.
